<?php
class ReviewBufferedSendOld37 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedSendNewInput37 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedSendRowNew37 { function __destruct() { echo "C|"; } }
function &reviewBufferedSendChild37() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewBufferedSendOld37()]; echo "C0|"; try { $received = yield 7 => $row; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CHILD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedSendLower37() { echo "L|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedSendUpper37() { echo "U|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["lower"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedSendTop37() { echo "T|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-TOP|"; } finally { echo "V|"; } }
function reviewBufferedSendOuter37() { echo "O|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["top"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$injected = new Exception("buffered-send37"); $child = reviewBufferedSendChild37(); $lower = reviewBufferedSendLower37(); $upper = reviewBufferedSendUpper37(); $top = reviewBufferedSendTop37(); $outer = reviewBufferedSendOuter37();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|"; $lower->send($row); echo "S1|THROW|";
try { $top->throw($injected); echo "BAD-THROW|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "S2|"; $snapshot = $upper->send([new ReviewBufferedSendNewInput37()]); echo "RET|", $snapshot[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedSendOld37 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$row[0] = new ReviewBufferedSendRowNew37(); echo "COW|", $snapshot[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedSendOld37 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedSendRowNew37 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($snapshot); echo "SNAP-DROP|";
unset($caught, $injected); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($top); echo "TOP|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|"; unset($row); echo "ROW|"; echo "E";
